text: City Council on May 24, 25 and 26, 2017 adopted Item TE24.50 – "Installation of On-Street Accessible Parking Space - April 2017 (Non-Delegated)". At its January 31 and February 1, 2018 meeting, City Council adopted Item TE29.53 – "Construction Staging Area – Davenport Road (128 Hazelton Avenue)". Implementation of the construction staging area at 128 Hazelton Avenue has resulted in the loss of one designated on-street accessible parking space on the north side of Davenport Road. In order to accommodate the accessible parking permit holder, the accessible parking space should be relocated further east. In addition, stopping was prohibited at all times on the south side of Davenport Road, adjacent to the site at 128 Hazelton Avenue and three on-street parking machine spaces were removed to facilitate inbound movements into the construction staging area. City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Item TE24.50 by replacing the measurement "130 metres" in Appendix A with the measurement "160 metres", so that the location of the accessible space shall now be as follows: "27 Davenport Road, north side, between a point 160 metres east of Avenue Road and a point 5.5 metres further east." 2. City Council amend Item TE29.53 by: a. replacing the measurement "90 metres" in Part 2 with the measurement "95.5 metres"; and b. replacing the measurement "70 metres" in Parts 5 and 7 with the measurement "88 metres".
